title: Farfuits
description: A simple farming technology mod that automatically creates, plants, harvests and manages farms from 3x3 to 15x15 using a single smart farming block.

## Overview

**Smart Farming. Simple Automation.**

Farfuits is a lightweight farming automation mod for Minecraft.

Build and maintain farms automatically with a single Farmer Drone Block. It creates farmland, plants crops, harvests mature crops, replants them, and stores everything in a nearby chest.

No energy. No cables. No complicated machines.

Just place the block, connect a chest, and let your farm work for you.

**Loader:** Fabric

**Minecraft Versions:** 1.21 to 26.2
